title: Comfort Club Loyalty Discount on Reinstated-Term Dues and the Appointment Record
content:
The dues of a reinstated Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements term carry a loyalty discount set by the agreement's consecutive term count and its record of missed-visit fees.

## Loyalty rule
- **Enhanced loyalty discount, 8%:** an agreement in at least **7** consecutive terms (the enhanced loyalty term count) with **no missed-visit fee charged within the 12 months before the date of handling** — no missed-appointment fee charge on its dues ledger dated in those 12 months.
- **The tier's loyalty discount:** an agreement in at least the tier's loyalty term count of consecutive terms (**3** on every Comfort Club tier) that does not meet both enhanced conditions.
- **Any other agreement:** no loyalty discount.

## The tier's loyalty discount

| Tier | Loyalty discount |
|---|---|
| Comfort Club Basic | 0% |
| Comfort Club Silver | 5% |
| Comfort Club Gold | 5% |
| Comfort Club Platinum | 5% |
| Comfort Club Platinum Plus | 10% |
| Comfort Club Total Home | 10% |

## Truth table (hypothetical Comfort Club Gold agreement)

| Consecutive terms | Missed-visit fee charged in the 12 months | Loyalty discount |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | none | 8% |
| 8 | one | 5% (the tier's) |
| 4 | none | 5% (the tier's) |
| 2 | none | none |
